Water.rationale: Specular reflection from water surface results in VV typically <= -17 dB, far lower than the other four classes; coherence is also low.

Urban_Builtup.secondary_check: med_vv_db should be maximum or second maximum due to double bounce scattering
Urban_Builtup.rationale: Permanent scatterers provide the highest 12-day interferometric coherence; double bounce produces high backscatter.

Forest.secondary_check: med_g12 should be relatively low due to volume decorrelation
Forest.rationale: Volume scattering enhances cross-polarization (VH-VV least negative) while canopy movement causes volume/temporal decorrelation.

Cropland_vs_Grassland.rationale: May agricultural phenological growth causes rapid 12-day intensity change, expected to be larger in Cropland than Grassland.

consistency_requirement: Urban (max g12) and Water (min vv) must be identical class_id across all four tracks (t15, t37, t88, t139); otherwise mark UNRESOLVED.
